title: Time-Correlated Video Bridge Matching
abstract: arXiv:2510.12453v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models excel in noise-to-data generation tasks, providing a mapping from a Gaussian distribution to a more complex data distribution. However, they struggle to model translations between complex distributions, limiting their effectiveness in data-to-data tasks. While Bridge Matching models address this by finding the translation between data distributions, their application to time-correlated data sequences remains unexplored. This is a critical limitation for video generation and manipulation tasks, where maintaining temporal coherence is particularly important. To address this gap, we propose Time-Correlated Video Bridge Matching (TCVBM), a framework that extends Bridge Matching to time-correlated data sequences in the video domain. translated_abstract: 扩散模型在噪声到数据的生成任务中表现出色，提供了从高斯分布到更复杂数据分布的映射。然而，它们在建模复杂分布之间的转换方面存在困难，限制了其在数据到数据任务中的有效性。虽然桥匹配模型通过寻找数据分布之间的转换来解决这一问题，但其在时间相关数据序列中的应用仍未得到探索。这对于视频生成和操作任务来说是一个关键限制，因为在这些任务中，保持时间连贯性尤为重要。为解决这一空白，我们提出了时间相关视频桥匹配（TCVBM），这是一个将桥匹配扩展到视频领域中时间相关数据序列的框架。TCVBM在扩散桥内显式建模序列间依赖关系，直接将时间相关性纳入采样过程。我们将我们的方法与经典方法进行比较。
tldr: 本文提出TCVBM框架，首次将桥匹配扩展到时间相关的视频序列，通过显式建模序列间依赖关系，在采样过程中直接融入时间相关性，从而提升视频生成和操作任务中的时间连贯性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TCVBM, a framework that extends Bridge Matching to time-correlated video sequences by explicitly modeling inter-sequence dependencies, directly incorporating temporal correlations into the sampling process to improve temporal coherence in video generation and manipulation tasks.
